scope: 13 identified mistranslations of pir+dative plus hand-pledge formula, not all occurrences of hand or together
primary_headword: кол; exact он эки бирге кол берген = follower of twelve ishans
method: Each affected PDF image and local source/English context personally inspected by assigned model worker; exact primary lexical entry read. Original source text/IDs/counts unchanged; no independent specialist review.

corrections.old: Twelve together pledged him their hands.
corrections.new: Having become a disciple of twelve spiritual guides,
corrections.note: Corrected after individual source PDF image/context review: primary Yudakhin кол entry quotes exact он эки бирге кол берген as being a follower of twelve ishans/spiritual guides.
